definition_en: The ability to be reliable, consistent, and thorough in completing tasks, ensuring accuracy and meeting commitments without close supervision.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk menjadi boleh diharap, konsisten dan teliti dalam menyiapkan tugasan, memastikan ketepatan serta menunaikan komitmen tanpa pengawasan rapi.
typical_tasks_en:
• Double-check every passport application form for missing signatures before submission.
• Submit the weekly payroll report on time for six consecutive months.
• Spot a mismatch between invoice amounts and purchase orders before payment.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Semak semula setiap borang permohonan pasport untuk tandatangan yang hilang sebelum dihantar.
• Hantar laporan gaji mingguan tepat pada masanya selama enam bulan berturut-turut.
• Kesan ketidakpadanan antara jumlah invois dan pesanan pembelian sebelum pembayaran.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires high accuracy and careful checking of work
• The task involves meeting deadlines and keeping commitments reliably
• The task requires following precise instructions or specifications
• The task involves detecting errors, omissions, or inconsistencies
• The task requires maintaining standards over repetitive work
exclusion_rules:
• The task allows for approximate or rough completion
• The user performs work without any need for verification or checking
• The task involves creative or exploratory work where precision is not required
• The user is intentionally prototyping or drafting rather than finalising
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task allows rough output, or is exploratory drafting where precision is not expected.

confusions.boundary_rule: Dependability is personal reliability. Quality control is checking outputs against standards.
confusions.example_task: Carefully verify that every product meets the size specification.
confusions.expected_labels: Quality control; Dependability and attention to detail

confusions.boundary_rule: Programming often requires precision, but it is a technology skill.
confusions.example_task: Write error-free code for the registration module.

confusions.boundary_rule: Dependability ensures accuracy. Analytical thinking interprets meaning.
confusions.example_task: Accurately compile monthly figures before analysing trends.
confusions.expected_labels: Dependability and attention to detail; Analytical thinking
